# Claude Cowork Guide

> Independent, community-maintained guide to Claude Cowork. Not affiliated with Anthropic.

## Verified guide facts

- Canonical URL: https://cowork.bruniaux.com/
- Source repository: https://github.com/FlorianBruniaux/claude-cowork-guide
- Guide version: 1.14.0
- Product facts last checked: 2026-10-11
- License: CC BY-SA 4.0
- Languages: English and French
- Corpus: 29 bilingual workflows and 70 numbered prompts

## Product scope

Cowork availability and capabilities depend on plan and surface. Since 2026-09-16 Cowork is built into Claude (Unified Claude, rolling out to Pro and Max): there is no separate Chat or Cowork mode. Cowork is for paid plans only (Pro, Max, Team, Enterprise). Since 2026-10-06, new Pro and Max tasks run in the cloud; folders stay on the computer and a cloud session reaches connected folders only while Claude Desktop is open. Desktop supports macOS 13+, Windows, and Linux in beta. Approval modes are Manual, Auto and Skip all approvals. Computer use is a beta for Pro and Max on macOS 14+ and Windows. Current models are the Claude 5.5 family (Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, Haiku 5.5). Claude Design, Slides and Docs are available in any conversation; Dashboards and Motion are in beta. Pricing is published in US dollars, excluding tax, at https://claude.com/pricing.
